description: Research reasoning and scientific writing skills for problem-mechanism-evidence alignment and evidence-bounded Elsevier/COMPAG manuscript editing.

capabilities: Research analysis Scientific writing Claim auditing Manuscript editing
defaultPrompt: Audit this technical argument for problem–mechanism–evidence consistency and flag unsupported causal claims.
Revise this text in concise COMPAG style while preserving technical meaning, frozen data, definitions, and evidence scope.
Check this manuscript for alignment among Introduction claims, Method mechanisms, experiments, Results, and Conclusion.
interface.longDescription: Checks technical arguments for problem, mechanism, and evidence alignment, then helps revise scientific manuscripts with evidence-bounded claims, consistent terminology, and concise Elsevier/COMPAG-style prose

name: research-writing-guardrails
